subject: Re: Pilot pricing for sampled tracing + seatless dashboard bundle
messages:
From: Jordan Lin <ops@acme-analytics.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya.patel@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot ask: sampled tracing + visualization (pricing/credits)

Hi Hannah and Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team liked the low-latency dashboards. We want to scope a 6-week pilot focused on two things:

- Sampled tracing (retain spans at 1% global sample + targeted 10% for P1 services)
- Seatless visualization bundle for infra/observability (no per-seat charges, flat ingestion + retention tiers)

Quick questions to help our procurement team:
1) Can you provide a pilot price with two crediting options: a) consumption-first (pay for trace ingest + retention tiers) and b) committed credits (monthly commitment with discount + overage).
2) What retention breakpoints do you recommend for our throughput (~120M trace events/month peak)?
3) Any SOW or legal caveats for a 6-week pilot in our env (VPC peering)?

Attaching our requirement doc. Would like a short call tomorrow to align.

Jordan
Ops Lead, Acme Analytics
ops@acme-analytics.com

Attachment: acme_sampled-trace_requirements.pdf (PDF, 1.3MB)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lin <ops@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot ask: sampled tracing + visualization (pricing/credits)

Hey Jordan — thanks for the detailed brief, this is helpful. High-level answers below and happy to jump on a 30-min sync.

Summary answers:
- We can run both pricing constructs for the pilot. Suggested pilot pricing: $8k/month (consumption-first estimate) vs $6k/month committed credits (30% discount) for the 6-week window, with overage at listed unit rates. (See attached draft pricing workbook.)
- Retention guidance: for 120M events/month we typically recommend a 14-day hot retention + 60-day cold tier for sampled traces; for targeted high-sensitivity services we map a 30-day hot window.
- SOW: VPC peering + SCIM-based access is standard; we'll send a short SOW and an ops checklist.

Open items for procurement:
- Whether they need seated access for dashboards (you asked seatless; confirm number of viewer seats for trial).
- Clarify expected peak ingest bursts and SLA for trace-query latency.

Proposed time: Wed 9:30am PT or 3pm PT.

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_pilot_pricing_v1.xlsx, SOW-template-acme.docx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Jordan Lin <ops@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot ask: sampled tracing + visualization (pricing/credits)

Thanks all — quick operations note and an alternate credit model to consider.

Ops note (for Jordan): for a VPC peering pilot we recommend enabling prefix/KV caching for high-cardinality traces to reduce billable token volume; we'll include recommended batching and a QoS profile so queries stay within the latency SLO.

Alternate credit model (2-tier committed):
- Tier A (Base commit): $4k/mo covers up to 60M trace events ingested + 14-day hot retention for sampled data.
- Tier B (Burst commit): optional $2k/mo covers an extra 60M events in bursts, auto-applied during spikes.
- Overage rate: $0.0025 per event over committed coverage (will scale down for sampled spans).

This hybrid makes the month-to-month cost predictable while covering burst risk. If procurement wants a single flat pilot cost we can special-case that with a credit escrow.

Soojin / Vanessa — can you confirm whether CS should ship any additional visualization templates for Acme's P1 services as part of the pilot? That affects the delivery estimate.

-Karthik
Principal Solutions Architect
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lin <ops@acme-analytics.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 14:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot ask: sampled tracing + visualization (pricing/credits)

Jordan — appreciate the quick turnaround. From a commercial perspective we can offer the following pilot concession:

- 6-week pilot flat fee: $7,000 (covers up to 120M sampled events total, standard retention profile as Hannah suggested).
- If Acme converts to a 12-month committed plan within 30 days post-pilot, we will credit 50% of the pilot fee back against month 1 of committed credits.
- Seatless dashboards: included during the pilot; production licensing will move to ingestion+retention pricing (no per-seat in current proposals).

Next steps:
1) Jordan — please confirm you want the flat-fee pilot (Option A) or the 2-tier committed model (Option B).
2) If Option A, I will circulate a short SOW and a single-line purchase order template to your procurement contact.

Thanks — looking forward to moving fast.

Soojin Lee
Director, Strategic Accounts
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
